title: X-Embedding: Two-Stage Training for Multilingual Patent Prior-Art Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.29521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multilingual patent prior-art retrieval requires identifying X-category references that are particularly relevant to the novelty or inventive step of a claimed invention, beyond topical similarity across languages and document views. We present X-Embedding, a two-stage framework that first learns patent-domain representations and then optimizes X-category retrieval relevance. The first stage aligns complementary sections within patents and corresponding sections across different-language patent-family members, learning from both patent structure and multilingual expressions. The second stage learns X-category relevance using examination-report X citations as positives and negatives drawn from retrieval candidates and A-category citations. Matryoshka representation learning (MRL) enables 64- and 1024-dimensional embeddings within one model. Evaluation on a common Chinese, English, and Japanese collection with four query views yields 89.09

translated_title: X-Embedding：面向多语言专利现有技术检索的两阶段训练方法
translated_abstract: 多语言专利现有技术检索需要识别对所要求保护的发明的新颖性或创造性（inventive step）特别相关的X类对比文献，而不仅仅是跨语言和跨文档视图的主题相似性匹配。我们提出了X-Embedding，这是一个两阶段框架：第一阶段学习专利领域的表示，第二阶段优化X类检索相关性。第一阶段通过对齐专利内部的互补章节以及不同语言专利族成员之间的对应章节，从专利结构和多语言表达中同时学习。第二阶段利用审查报告中的X类引用作为正样本，并从检索候选结果和A类引用中抽取负样本，来学习X类相关性。借助Matryoshka表示学习（MRL），单个模型即可输出64维和1024维的嵌入向量。在一个包含中文、英文和日文、并采用四种查询视图的通用数据集上进行评估，取得了89.09（原文在此处截断）的结果。
tldr: 提出两阶段训练框架X-Embedding，先通过专利内部章节对齐与跨语言专利族对齐学习专利领域表示，再利用审查报告X类引用作为监督信号优化检索相关性，有效提升多语言专利现有技术检索中X类文献的识别能力。
en_tdlr: X-Embedding is a two-stage training framework that first learns patent-domain representations through intra-patent section alignment and cross-lingual patent-family alignment, then optimizes X-category retrieval relevance using examination-report citations, significantly improving multilingual patent prior-art retrieval performance.
